root_cause: Every detectron2 precommit test (19/19 parametrizations) fails identically: loading a detectron2 config calls DetectionCheckpointer.load(cfg.MODEL.WEIGHTS), which routes the pretrained-weight URL through iopath's PathManager.get_local_path -> download(), which uses Python's urllib.request.urlretrieve. This raises 'SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED: certificate has expired' on every retry (3 attempts). This indicates the TLS certificate presented by the remote weight host (dl.fbaipublicfiles.com, Facebook/Meta's public model file storage used by detectron2's model zoo) had expired at the time of this run, an external-service outage entirely outside the OpenVINO codebase and unrelated to the merged commit (#39495, a GroupQueryAttention ONNX FE/GPU feature touching core/ONNX FE/GPU sources only, with no bearing on model-hub test infrastructure or TLS trust stores).
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible locally unless the remote certificate is still expired at the time of testing. To approximate: run `python -c "from urllib.request import urlretrieve; urlretrieve('https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/detectron2/COCO-Detection/faster_rcnn_R_50_FPN_1x/137257794/model_final_b275ba.pkl', '/tmp/w.pkl')"` and observe whether an SSL certificate-expiry error is raised; or run `openssl s_client -connect dl.fbaipublicfiles.com:443 -servername dl.fbaipublicfiles.com </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates` to check the certificate's current validity window.
recommended_actions: Treat this as a transient external-service (Meta/Facebook CDN) certificate issue; re-run the 'PyTorch Models tests' job once the certificate is renewed upstream (this doctor does not auto-rerun; a maintainer should trigger the rerun).

Monitor dl.fbaipublicfiles.com certificate validity; if it remains expired for an extended period, consider mirroring detectron2 pretrained weights to an internal/cached storage location used by CI to decouple test stability from this third-party host.

Add a CI-level pre-flight check (e.g., a lightweight HTTPS HEAD request with `verify=True`) before the detectron2 test suite runs, to fail fast with a clearer 'external host certificate invalid' message instead of 19 duplicated pytest failures.
prevention_strategies: Model-hub tests that fetch third-party pretrained weights over HTTPS are inherently coupled to the availability and certificate hygiene of external hosts outside OpenVINO's control. Mitigate by caching/mirroring frequently used weight files (e.g., via an internal artifact proxy) so CI does not depend on live reachability of dl.fbaipublicfiles.com, and by adding a single upfront connectivity/certificate check for the external host so failures are reported once with a clear message rather than once per parametrized test case.
historical_context: No prior post-commit investigation in this knowledge base matches this exact signature (detectron2 weight download / dl.fbaipublicfiles.com certificate expiry); this is a new pattern. A superficially similar prior pattern (hash 5af712f5b77c1b2d) covers DNS-resolution failures reaching Ubuntu apt mirrors in the unrelated 'Debian Packages' job and is not the same root cause (DNS failure vs. expired TLS certificate on a third-party CDN).
